recommendation.summary: dsh-agy-link@0.4.40 is a DSH plugin that bridges the official unmodified `agy` (Google Antigravity) CLI into DSH as an `antigravity` model provider, with multi-account pooling, quota monitoring, and in-GUI OAuth login. Node 24 is the only evidenced major: both CI workflows configure node-version 24, package.json and the published manifest declare engines.node ">=24.0.0", and the README prerequisites table lists "Node.js ≥ 24" in every language variant. No explicit author recommendation naming a major was found, so the selection is recorded as ci-tested rather than author-recommended; the DSH repository baseline (^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0) cannot be selected because it would contradict the plugin's own engines range. The manifest declares dsh.client.platform=web and the quick start installs into the named `web` profile and launches `dsh web`, so web is the primary workflow; the README's "Headless operation" section documents headless/print operation with permission-mode caveats, so headless is retained as an additional workflow. No TUI, SDK, or ACP workflow is documented. No exact package-manager version and no author DSH version baseline are evidenced, so those arrays are empty and recorded as coverage gaps. This recommendation records repository intent only; it is not proof of compatibility, and authenticated Google/Antigravity paths remain unverified.
